name: Horizon of Spikes
body:
School conjuration; Level legendary ninja 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one 20-ft. square/level
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex partial; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You fill the area with a mass of caltrops that move and shift to injure your enemies. The area is considered difficult terrain for your enemies and any enemy passing through the area takes 1 damage per 5 feet moved, and/or if they spend an action attacking, they take 1 damage. You and your allies are unaffected. A creature that takes damage must make a Reflex save or injure their feet. Their speed is reduced by half for 24 hours or until they receive healing via a spell or a Heal check against the DC of the spell.
